description:
[Trading Data API] DefiLlama data: TVL by chain, stablecoin circulating supply, or yield pools.

**Example:** `/v1/defi-tvl?view=chains`

Use when you need DeFi TVL by chain, stablecoin supply or yield pools from DefiLlama. Not for the health or risk of one protocol (use protocol_health_score).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

chain.description: Optional (yields view). Filter pools by chain, e.g. Ethereum.

project.description: Optional (yields view). Filter pools by project, e.g. aave-v3.

name: defi_tvl
